rules.text:
B · Glass, with what the app can draw: a backdrop image behind everything, flat smoked-glass fills (no sheen gradients), 1px light rims, the shadow presets, SVG icons, Inter + JetBrains Mono. No background blur.

Rules: one outline per stack (the machine card), fill steps inside it. Radii are concentric: box 16 → card 12 → capsule 9 → row 6. Mono only for ids, branches and numbers. The attention-states board is still in the flat Graphite colours.
